description: Ministry of Labour and Foreign Employment - The Industrial Disputes between Mr. R. P. P. Jayakidi, Veyangala and Employee's Trust Fund Board Colombo 08
categorisation: This gazette content primarily concerns legal/regulatory matters under the Industrial Disputes Act, specifically an order appointing an arbitrator to settle an industrial dispute between an individual and the Employees' Trust Fund Board. It references specific legislative enactments (Chapter 131 of the Legislative Enactments of Ceylon) and exercises powers under Section 4(1) of the Act. While it mentions a minister's name, this is in the context of exercising statutory authority rather than detailing government personnel changes or portfolio responsibilities.
